author: Springer, 1939

note.en: A small, slim shark of sandy shelves that eats crabs and shrimps and has flat, crushing teeth. FishBase lists it for Costa Rica, but we found no local record. It could be called cazón by fishers.
note.es: Un tiburón pequeño y delgado de plataformas arenosas que come cangrejos y camarones y tiene dientes planos para triturar. FishBase lo lista para Costa Rica, pero no encontramos registros locales. Los pescadores podrían llamarlo cazón.

evidence: No local record found; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic (coast not stated)

sources.t: IUCN Red List: Mustelus norrisi, Near Threatened

recWhy: Only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica; no local record.
